About the Opportunity  

 Due to a departed doctor who has left the practice, one of our private billing clients in the Rokeby area is currently taking expressions of interest from vocationally registered general practitioners who are available to join their friendly practice on either a full-time or part-time basis. Based in a convenient shopping location with several consulting rooms and ample car spots you will be working next door to a chemist amongst various retailers located within the complex.  Over the past 30 years the surgery has continued to grow with the local community by keeping up with the latest developments and progress in healthcare to meet their patients’ concerns, whilst delivering quality care to men, women and children of all ages. In conjunction with a proactive team of nurses, allied healthcare professionals, administration staff and pathology; services often sought out here include vaccinations, minor surgical procedures, care plans, physical rehabilitation and hearing tests. We look forward to hearing from interested candidates. 

  Essential Criteria:  

 
	 MBBS or equivalent 
	 Must have a current and valid AHPRA GENERAL /SPECIALIST registration 
	 FRACGP qualified 
	 Good team player 
   Apply Now

About the Opportunity  

 A very busy bulk billing family practice established for almost 8 years in the Macarthur region is needing more vocationally registered general practitioners to join their small, close-knit team of two male doctors. Open all day weekdays and half day Saturdays patients are seen on both an appointment and walk-in basis with expected patient numbers sitting around 35 - 40 a day during a 9:00am - 4:00pm shift, or around 45 patients a day working until 5:00pm. Range of services available here include preventative medicine, mental health care plans and assessments, teenage health issues, health checks and assessments for kids and newborns, men and women's health issues with onsite pathology and full-time nursing support. The clinic is located next to a grocery store and Spotlight behind an arcade with a handful of other shops, retailers and services and plenty of parking nearby. They're currently booked out a few days in advance so you won't be short of patients! If you're unrestricted and available for your next role please  APPLY  now.
